source.title: Transformer Modular Addition Through A Signal Processing Lens

record.file_problem: The post text is present, but the linked Google Colab notebook and the promised second notebook are not included.
record.tranche_reason: The post takes the modular-addition grokking model as the subject of a signal-processing analysis, but does not report results on the claim versions' training trajectory or delayed generalization.
record.gate_note: The author says they visualized attention-layer symmetries that continue through the model and ran tests about sinusoid phase. The post does not state the phase-test results or report training/test accuracy over time, gradual circuit formation, or removal of memorizing components. The notebook contents are unavailable.
record.test_reason: The post analyses the already-grokked modular-addition transformer from Nanda et al. through a signal-processing lens. It reports only a qualitative visualization of attention-layer symmetries. It gives no accuracy trajectories, no training dynamics, and no comparison across runs or regimes, so no claim version is tested.
record.authors_conclusion: Roughly correct. The author claims to have visualized attention-layer symmetries that continue through the model and believes they drive the generalizing algorithm. The author also says phase tests confirm properties of the sinusoids, but gives no results, and invites feedback.
record.recipe_differences: The post describes signal-processing and sinusoid-phase analysis rather than a reported training-trajectory experiment; the linked notebook is not available in the supplied text.

fits_no_version.finding: The author reports visualizing attention-layer symmetries in the modular-addition transformer that continue through later layers. No quantification is given.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: In the grokked modular-addition transformer, symmetries in attention-layer sinusoids propagate through the model and underlie the generalizing algorithm.

record.problems: The supplied post does not include the linked notebook, detailed methods, quantitative results, or the stated phase-test outcomes; no controls or uncertainty estimates are reported in the post.
record.rows_left_out: No additional results are stated in the supplied post. The author's mention of many phase tests lacks reported outcomes and is not a separately recordable result.

Gradual circuit formation, removal of memorizing components, and progress measures anticipating the jump. The post describes only the final algorithm's structure.

Comparison of algorithms across runs, architectures or hyperparameters.

record.verdict_notes: The post is a short link to a Colab notebook that was not supplied. The evidence is qualitative and unpublished (LessWrong, score 1), and the study is not an original source.
